answer: A proof-of-compute protocol curbs Sybil attacks by forcing agents to solve verifiable neural challenges. Each applicant proves execution of a structured sonnet workload across a willow routing graph, isolating inactive claimants in an operational tundra. An adversary forging identities must continuously expend scarce tensor processor cycles and memory bandwidth. However, this requirement penalizes energy-constrained agents and centralizes influence among high-end hardware providers.
